safety_boundaries: Discovery never installs, executes, authenticates, spends money, or grants authority.
Capability sources are disabled unless explicitly enabled and trusted by the active discovery policy.
External source retrieval is HTTPS-only and bounded by explicit host, timeout, and response-size controls.
Lifecycle transitions are explicit and state-validated; capability approval requires permission.
Executive tasks must explicitly declare objective scope and capability approval is explicit.
Resource management reserves only registered resources and fails closed on unknown quantitative capacity.
Resource leases expire and release capacity; lease persistence does not grant authority.
Telemetry is evidence, not authority, and health requires sufficient observations.
Only verified research claims enter the verified synthesis contract.
Contradictory or low-confidence synthesis signals cannot become executive requirements.
Autonomous plans are scope-bound and permission-preflighted before any action is executed.
Autonomous plan size is bounded and execution stops on failed actions.
Routing selects only registered, approved, healthy, requirement-compatible specialists and never grants authority.
Routing fallbacks remain subject to the same eligibility requirements.
Autonomous improvement can propose changes but cannot mutate code, handlers, permissions, credentials, or authority.
Learning accepts only verified same-scope evidence and emits reversible proposals.
Learned routing preference is bounded advisory scoring only and cannot override hard eligibility gates.
Natural-language input never grants authority or directly creates executable actions.
Provider semantic output is untrusted data and cannot bypass scope, confidence, ambiguity, or high-impact gates.
Semantic evaluation records structured outcomes only and never executes actions or grants authority.
Cognitive state and self-model are descriptive, bounded, scope-aware, and have no authority or permission mutation path.
Awareness aggregation only produces bounded observations; it does not publish, authenticate, contact, or grant distribution authority.
Unified discovery only observes local resources and trusted catalogs; resource reservation remains separate from capability authority.
Recovery is externally authorized and protected against tampering, expiry, and replay.
No unrestricted self-modification, automatic paid acquisition, credential fabrication, CAPTCHA bypass, or platform-control bypass.
